author: Good Enough
description:
Born in Tennessee in 1868, Myrtle Corbin became one of the most famous performers in circus history. She was born with a rare condition called dipygus, which caused her to have two pelvises and four legs.

As a child, Myrtle was put on display in traveling sideshows where crowds were fascinated by her unique condition. Despite the challenges she faced early in life, she eventually gained control over her career and became one of the highest paid performers of her time.
